name: globe
title: Globe
description: A dotted WebGL globe with markers and arcs, drawn by COBE, that turns on its own and spins with a spring and momentum when dragged.
label: COBE
author: Shu Ding <https://github.com/shuding>

props.name: markers
props.type: { location: [number, number]; size: number; color?: [number, number, number]; id?: string }[]
props.description: Points at [latitude, longitude] in degrees. An id exposes the anchor --cobe-<id> and the variable --cobe-visible-<id>.

props.name: arcs
props.type: { from: [number, number]; to: [number, number]; color?: [number, number, number]; id?: string }[]
props.description: Curves between two points. An id exposes --cobe-arc-<id> and --cobe-visible-arc-<id> at the arc's top.

props.name: speed
props.description: Auto-rotation in radians per second (0 stops it); 0.8 times as fast under the pointer, paused while dragged or focused.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag to spin, with a spring and momentum; with a label, the arrow keys turn and tilt it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the globe (role="img"); without it the globe is decorative and stays out of the tab order.

props.name: options
props.description: Passed to cobe: diffuse (1.2), mapSamples (16000), mapBrightness (6), mapBaseBrightness, arcWidth (0.5), arcHeight (0.3), markerElevation, scale, offset, opacity, dark and colors (which override the tokens).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static SVG globe shown without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: Laid over the globe, for labels anchored to marker and arc ids.

a11y: With label it is role="img" with that name; without one it is decorative (aria-hidden) and not focusable.

A labelled, interactive globe is focusable with a visible focus ring: Left and Right turn it 15 degrees, Up and Down tilt it, Home returns to the starting view. The arrows follow the physical direction in right-to-left pages too. Rotation pauses while it has focus.
Under reduced motion, without WebGL 2 and before the land map has loaded it shows a static SVG globe with the same colors, markers and arcs; nothing moves.
On touch screens a vertical swipe still scrolls the page; a horizontal one spins the globe.
usage: <Globe markers={[{ location: [37.78, -122.44], size: 0.03 }]} label="Where we work" className="max-w-md" />
